title: Expression real-literal code generation

scope.rationale: Expression compilation now routes floating integer fallback through the source-shaped real-literal opcode helper.

external_source_responsibilities: SQLite floating parser and VDBE operation builder
dependencies.caller_closure: The helper is called by production integer literal fallback for out-of-range real values.

inputs: VDBE, zero-terminated numeric text, negation flag, destination register
contracts.ownership: VDBE owns duplicated P4 real payload.
contracts.state_and_results: Parses, optionally negates, rejects NaN by invariant, and appends one operation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Operation builder owns sticky OOM behavior.

representation_differences: Uses the typed SQLite float parser and canonical VDBE P4 helper.

oracle.protocol: Compile representative positive, negative, boundary, and integer-overflow literals.
oracle.normalization: Compare decoded IEEE-754 value and opcode operands.

assurance.continuation: One opcode appended on source-valid input.
assurance.performance: Linear numeric parse plus constant opcode append.

integration.native_call_path: codeInteger overflow fallback -> codeReal -> VDBE builder
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline real fallback replaced by source-shaped helper.

known_blockers: Focused pinned-C opcode trace and evidence-state promotion.

callers: Integer and real literal expression compilation
upstream_tests: Float decode, VDBE builder, and broad runtime differentials
